note.title: Celebrity culture
note.specFocus: Famous people, role models, celebrity influence, fans, social media, fame, success, money, privacy, advertising, and responsible behaviour.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Celebrity culture

Key vocabulary
- el/la famoso/a; la celebridad; el modelo a seguir; el seguidor; la fama; el éxito; influir en; admirar; la privacidad; donar; la publicidad; cotillear; responsable

Key grammar
- Use aunque/sin embargo for balanced views. Use haber + past participle for recent effects if appropriate, and the conditional to suggest what celebrities or fans should do.

Exam tips
- Avoid uncritical admiration: state a positive influence and a limitation. Make clear whether a celebrity, a fan or a journalist is speaking.

questions.examTip: Build a short description, an opinion with porque and a personal or hypothetical comment.
questions.modelAnswer:
En la foto se ve una cantante que firma fotografías para un grupo de seguidores. Las personas parecen concentradas y de buen humor. A mi parecer, esta situación es positiva porque muestra algo importante sobre las personas famosas y su influencia. Además, me gustaría participar porque sería una experiencia útil y memorable.

(English: In the photo I can see a singer signing photographs for a group of fans. The people seem focused and in good spirits. In my opinion, this situation is positive because it shows something important about the topic. I would also like to take part because it would be useful and memorable.)

questions.examTip: Cover all bullets and keep speaking; an opinion plus reason is better than a long but unfinished sentence.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Admiro a una actriz que dona parte de su sueldo a hospitales. A mi modo de ver es importante porque tiene ventajas para mí y para otras personas. — (Unexpected question) Creo que las celebridades deberían reconocer sus errores.

(English: — I admire an actress who donates part of her salary to hospitals. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — I think celebrities should admit their mistakes.)
